name: agent-context-engineering
description: Engineer effective context packages that enable AI agents to execute tasks with complete understanding and minimal ambiguity.

inputs.name: task_definition
inputs.description: Clear description of what the agent needs to accomplish

inputs.name: agent_capabilities
inputs.description: Understanding of the agent's tools, knowledge, and limitations

inputs.name: existing_codebase
inputs.description: Access to relevant code, documentation, and artifacts

inputs.name: success_criteria
inputs.description: How to measure if the agent completed the task correctly

inputs.name: previous_agent_outputs
inputs.description: Context from earlier agents in the workflow

inputs.name: domain_knowledge
inputs.description: Business rules, technical constraints, compliance requirements

inputs.name: error_history
inputs.description: Previous failures and their root causes

outputs.name: context_package
outputs.description: Structured collection of information for agent consumption

outputs.name: context_map
outputs.description: Visual or structured representation of context relationships

outputs.name: retrieval_strategy
outputs.description: How and when the agent should access different context elements

outputs.name: validation_checklist
outputs.description: Criteria to verify context completeness and quality
